SOURCE ONLY, UNCOMPILED/UNEXECUTED. This component projects a complete stored

## Existing operations and precise labels

The existing source_population::unordered_forest validates the actual witness,
maps local Copy leaves through context.global_labels, and recursively orders
children by least leaf. The original source retains the entire ordered tree/
population/register carrier through every word step; quotienting occurs only
in this declared final observer. UnrankedGenealogyObservation supplies the
corresponding original unordered-tree quotient: child swaps and congruence,
with original labels and binary ancestry retained.

Menus reuse the existing LAW inlet Readout/ReadoutBasis finite map types.
Each menu explicitly chooses LocalCopyPositions or OriginalGlobalCopyLabels.
Local mode uses the original local tree/split string functions on the local
0..m Copy universe. Global mode uses the original injective, possibly unsorted,
possibly nonconsecutive global Copy labels. Rooted strings reuse the same
canonical tree renderer. Global split complements use the ACTUAL sorted global
label universe; the old split_string's0..m complement is valid only in local
mode. There is no conversion through floating point or positional lookup by a
large global label. Original source/sample/global embeddings remain stored.

The global splitter is the retained old split definition with an explicit
universe argument. This is a SOURCE adaptation, not a newly checked theorem
or native-control result. Its exact source and old function pins are in
G7-WORD-READOUT-SOURCE-REVIEW.json. Correspondence to the authorized original
unrooted observer and actual Copy relabelling remains an explicit obligation.

## One result, all menus

project_completed consumes one owning WordTable and retains it in a Batch,
along with the exact immutable menu slice. It requires AncestralComplete and
nonempty Copy, validates each native range witness and original ancestral-root
singleton, and then uses the existing complete unordered_forest. It projects
the SAME full row polynomial into each menu's declared outcome. Every formal
terminal must have an outcome; any missing map entry refuses the whole Batch.

project_empty_copy is a SEPARATE receiver for empty Copy with a FullView
finite-word endpoint. It validates empty live/genealogy/population fields and
projects every retained register row to the declared empty-forest/split key[]
(with string encoding "[]"). Batch.observer distinguishes EmptyCopyEndpoint
from CompletedTree. Each menu still has mass1. This uses the actual empty
unranked-forest observation; it does not assert a Nonempty Copy completed-tree
signature or identify zero output dimension with zero sampled copies.
The original natural register mixture remains retained behind that observer.

All original register/population/witness information remains accessible through
the stored complete WordTable. Register erasure is final-observer behavior;
it does not prove that arbitrary future transitions ignored those bits. A
FullView/empty-copy endpoint is not silently treated as a completed readout.

Every menu block has exact formal polynomial mass1. The complete blocks remain
separate; concatenation is not one PMF and is not automatically a legal affine
programme. Sampling/readout menus do not create original forcing rows/sites.
No state or model is omitted after a failure. Key, cell, coefficient-work,
retained-term and rational-bit limits yield construction unavailability,
never source NO. These counters do not enforce global allocator/controller
memory, wall time or encrypted persistence.
